_comment: Backfill strings for Buddy v4 (PIN-protected notes, onboarding wizard, note form) and v5 (photo contacts, medication alarms). English is the reference: every language must end up with exactly the same key set as 'en'. Keys already present in a language are left alone - these are only the ones that were missing. Run scripts/apply-buddy-i18n.js to apply, scripts/check-buddy-i18n.js to verify.
